To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the subjects' perceptions of their wellness were related to their resiliency, their meta-aging, their vital involvement in life, and their ability to adapt to changes in their environment and in their own health.
resiliency, vital involvement, and meta-aging appear to be the most important factors promoting wellness for the elderly.

the aged persons who were interviewed perceived wellness as a state in which they were able to function in their daily lives, and that their wellness was promoted by resiliency, a sense of meta-aging, vital involvement, and the ability to adapt to changes in their environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the aged person's own perceptions of his or her healthy aging.
the factors promoting healthy aging.
the factors that promote wellness and quality of life in the aged person.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
wellness in the aged is a state of well-being that is influenced by the individual's perception and interpretation and the interaction of the individual with his or her environment.

the aged person's wellness is a function of the individual's perception of wellness, the individual's interpretation of the present state of his or her health, and the individual's ability to cope and adapt to change.
the aged are a vital and dynamic group of people, and their wellness depends on their own perceptions of themselves and their own lives.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the subjects in this study were healthy, happy, and well.
the aged are not passive recipients of care.
the aged person is a dynamic individual with an active interest in life.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the aged person's wellness is influenced by the person's ability to cope with life events, the person's ability and willingness to continue to learn, the person's involvement in the community, and the person's ability, interest, and willingness to continue involvement in activities that are meaningful and enjoyable.
older adults have a lot to offer to the world, and they can continue to do so if they are encouraged and supported to do so.
wellness is a multidimensional concept that can be defined in a number of ways.
